classifications.rationale: The President presently declares a national emergency based on the stated threat determination; the legally consequential emergency status arises in this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: hereby declare a national emergency to deal with that threat

classifications.rationale: The President establishes an executive-branch policy of pursuing coordinated international efforts, without itself changing legal rights or compelling a specified later legal result.
classifications.evidence: It is the policy of the United States to lead and seek multilaterally coordinated efforts

classifications.rationale: The President directs the Secretaries, principally Commerce following joint determinations and regulations, to impose a specified later export prohibition; the segment also assigns diplomatic priorities and negotiations.
classifications.evidence: The Secretary of Commerce shall prohibit the export of any goods, technology, or services subject to his export jurisdiction

classifications.rationale: Although the Secretaries must prepare a list and pursue negotiations, the segment itself establishes a conditional exemption from the export controls for qualifying destination countries.
classifications.evidence: Subsection (a) will not apply to exports if their destination is a country with whose government the United States has entered into a bilateral or multilateral arrangement

classifications.rationale: The segment itself establishes mandatory sanctions and a procurement prohibition upon the Secretary's specified determinations, while assigning officials ministerial implementation and exemption authority.
classifications.evidence: No department or agency of the United States Government may procure, or enter into any contract for the procurement of, any goods or services from any foreign person referred to in subsection (1).

classifications.rationale: The segment itself imposes enumerated sanctions and fixes their duration upon specified country determinations, with officials later identifying covered countries and implementing particular restrictions.
classifications.evidence: No assistance shall be provided to that country under the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 or the Arms Export Control Act

classifications.rationale: The President authorizes and directs agency implementation, consultation, redelegation, and appropriate enforcement measures; the effectiveness and publication clauses are administrative and do not independently impose a new substantive consequence here.
classifications.evidence: are hereby authorized and directed to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations, as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this order
